subcategory: Animated SVG wave background with cursor interaction
use_cases: Landing page hero background with organic flowing wave animations
Interactive decorative element for creative portfolios and showcases
Ambient visual layer for SaaS dashboards and media applications
ai_summary: An interactive animated SVG wave background component that uses simplex noise algorithms to create organic, flowing wave patterns. The component responds dynamically to mouse and touch movements, generating ripple effects that influence wave distortion. Fully configurable with customizable stroke colors, background colors, and pointer interaction intensity. Optimized for smooth performance using requestAnimationFrame, with responsive design that adapts to both desktop and mobile platforms.
